# artifactkeeper_repository (Data Source)

Looks up an existing repository by its key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "artifactkeeper_repository" "docker" {
  key = "docker-local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Repository key to look up.

### Read-Only

- `allow_anonymous_access` (Boolean)
- `apt_description` (String) Custom APT Release Description, if set.
- `apt_label` (String) Custom APT Release Label, if set.
- `apt_origin` (String) Custom APT Release Origin, if set.
- `apt_release_version` (String) Custom APT Release Version, if set.
- `created_at` (String)
- `custom_user_agent` (String) Custom outbound User-Agent, if set.
- `description` (String)
- `format` (String)
- `format_key` (String) Write-only; not returned by the API.
- `has_trusted_gpg_key` (Boolean) Whether a trusted upstream GPG public key is configured.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `index_upstream_url` (String) Write-only; not returned by the API.
- `is_public` (Boolean)
- `members` (List of String) For `virtual` repositories: ordered member repository keys. Null for non-virtual repositories.
- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the assigned project, if any.
- `promotion_only` (Boolean) Whether direct uploads are rejected (promotion-only).
- `pypi_upstream_index_path` (String) Write-only; not returned by the API.
- `quota_bytes` (Number)
- `repo_type` (String)
- `storage_backend` (String) Write-only; not returned by the API.
- `storage_used_bytes` (Number)
- `trusted_gpg_key` (String, Sensitive) Write-only; never returned (see `has_trusted_gpg_key`).
- `updated_at` (String)
- `upstream_auth_configured` (Boolean)
- `upstream_auth_type` (String)
- `upstream_url` (String)
- `versioning_enabled` (Boolean) Whether first-class artifact versioning is enabled.
